text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente won the Nakayama Kinen. Air 
Groove praises her, noting how much 
stronger she has become.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the academy, they watched a 
broadcast about the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe with Duramente. At the end of the 
program, a poll of race fans was shown.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
“Who do you want to see challenge the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe this year?” Along 
with Duramente, names like Kitasan Black 
and Satono Crown were also brought up.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Everyone wished for the strongest 
Umamusume they supported to win the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe. Hearing this, 
Duramente fell into deep thought.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
After that, she announced that she wanted 
to run in the Osaka Hai alongside Kitasan 
Black. She had a feeling she would find 
something there.
